hypothesis: Consecutive frozen-evaluator token ranks contribute authorship information beyond their marginal distribution and improve a fixed held-out discriminative reference.
method_scope: Independent short-paragraph adaptation; paper evidence concerns long books, not this dataset. Frozen evaluator is not a proxy for source tokenizers.
rank_definition: One plus number of strictly larger logits; ties share rank. No BOS/EOS added; token zero has no score.
features: 24 marginal/position features plus 16 transition frequencies = 40 dimensions. Each third: four bucket frequencies, mean entropy, mean surprisal, mean log rank, surprisal standard deviation. Empty thirds zero.
gate: All five fold blend gains positive, pooled balanced-accuracy gain >=0.005, prompt-bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; transitions must outperform marginal-only fixed blend. Previously inspected folds, not pristine confirmation. No full-ensemble leaderboard claim.
execution: Not launched. Start with 100-row throughput/causal-alignment probe. CPU/MPS preferred if benchmark projects <=1 hour. Otherwise root chooses Kaggle execution; no paid compute authorized by this protocol.
reference_description: Raw V34 8B component scores, not fixed sparse blend and not full leaderboard ensemble.
